meta.title: Coat by the Door
meta.notes: Coldwave, deadpan male vocal (Kokoro am_michael). Plan: 128 bars (about 3:33) = intro 8, verse1 16, chorus1 16, verse2 16, chorus2 16, bridge 16, verse3a 8 (no drums), verse3b 8, chorus3 16, outro 8 (fade). Kept apart from the bundled demo: 144 bpm and D minor, verse i iv VI v, chorus VI VII i v, lofi drum kit, PWM pad, filtered saw lead, rising guitar sequence in the chorus. Vocal range: verses A2-F3 close to speech, choruses D3-Bb3 (a third to a fifth higher). Verse lines share one anapest rhythm (two eighths then a stressed beat); line-final words that end on a stop or fricative get 1.5 beats, open or nasal endings get 2.5 beats.

lines.text: I have heard my own words
in another man's mouth
I have split my last smoke
with the ones who walked out
So I learned a new rule
from the ash on the floor
smile at all of them, yes
keep your coat by the door
Never mind, never mind
I have seen this before
I was careful enough
and it happened once more
You did well, by the way
it was quick, it was clean
I'd have done it the same
I have done it, I mean
So this time I was slow
half a year, maybe more
kept my words to myself
kept my coat by the door
Then one night by the stove
you were lovely and kind
so I told you it all
and it went down the line
Never mind, never mind
I have seen this before
I was careful enough
and it happened once more
You did well, by the way
it was quick, it was clean
I'd have done it the same
I have done it, I mean
People talk, people go
drift like smoke, melt like snow
I will open my coat
to the next one I know
I will tell them it all
and they'll put in the knife
then I'll stagger a while
and go on with my life
Never mind, never mind
I have seen this before
I was careful enough
and it happened once more
You did well, by the way
it was quick, it was clean
I'd have done it the same
I have done it, I mean
